candidates.name: Melanoma
support_spans: strong positivity for vimentin and focal positivity for Melan-A and HMB-45

candidates.why: The immunohistochemical staining shows some features of melanoma, but other characteristics are not typical.

candidates.name: Leiomyosarcoma
support_spans: nests and fascicles of spindle-shaped to epithelioid cells with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, vesicular nuclei, and prominent nucleoli
